items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: but we had lunch with Julia

ctx.x: Well you’ve written arrangements for Maxine Sullivan and some other singers, Lee Wiley.
Yeah. Wonderful, wonderful. We had lunch with Dick Hyman’s wife a couple of years ago at the Mohonk Mountain House or something.
